entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by a UE after starting initial or non-initial registration procedure while waiting for network response.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE initiates registration with the network for the first time.

entities.name: Non-initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE performs registration after initial registration.

entities.name: Waiting for network response
entities.description: Condition where UE has sent registration request and is awaiting network response.

relations.description: Starting initial registration procedure causes UE to enter 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
Starting non-initial registration procedure causes UE to enter 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state implies UE is waiting for network response.
